understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by arranging all selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' was occupied at the same time, within the limited step budget, to trigger a WIN and ultimately complete the full set of levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were taken one step at a time with a finite remaining-steps counter. Directional moves would shift the currently selected piece around the grid until constrained by walls/obstacles, and pieces could not pass through blocked tiles. CLICK selected/teleported the active piece to a specific coordinate when that move was legal; if the target was blocked or otherwise invalid, the piece would not move. With multiple selectable pieces, you could switch which piece you were controlling by clicking on/at the other piece’s position, and success required coordinating all pieces to cover all '+' goal tiles simultaneously.

understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were taken one step at a time with a finite remaining-steps counter. Directional moves would shift the currently selected piece around the grid until constrained by walls/obstacles, and pieces could not pass through blocked tiles. CLICK selected/teleported the active piece to a specific coordinate when that move was legal; if the target was blocked or otherwise invalid, the piece would not move.
